items.title: The injective hull of a domain modulo a prime is indecomposable and localizes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a prime p of a ring the injective hull of R/p is indecomposable, is the injective hull of the residue field, and is also the injective hull of the residue field over the local ring at p (author lemma at source lines 813-823, label lemma-injective-hull-indecomposable). The proof (source lines 825-843) uses the essentialness of R/p inside the residue field and the uniqueness of injective hulls for the second and third parts, the action of elements outside the prime to descend the module structure to the local ring, and shows indecomposability by intersecting an arbitrary nonzero injective submodule with R/p and upgrading the resulting inclusion of hulls to an isomorphism (proof lines 835-842). The indecomposability argument is the substance. H3.
